# Contributing

Suggest a tool with the [Add a tool](https://github.com/HappyHackingSpace/ai-security-arsenal/issues/new?template=add-tool.yml)
issue form. A bot checks it and opens a pull request; a maintainer reviews and merges it.

## Rules

A tool is listed only if all of these hold:

1. **It is a tool**: something you install, run or import (CLI, library, server, MCP server, plugin, skill pack,
   benchmark, lab, payload set). Not an article, paper, guide, course or curated list.
2. **It is about AI security**: it attacks AI, defends AI, or uses AI to do security work.
3. **It is open source on GitHub** with at least 10 stars.
4. **It is not a malware, RAT, C2 or phishing builder**, even if AI-powered.
5. **It goes in one category**, chosen by its main purpose.
